item.title: Geraldton softball: Blockbuster top-of-table clash headlines final round of women’s regular season
item.description: A pivotal weekend awaits the Geraldton Softball Association with finals just around the corner and ladder positions beginning to harden, with the women’s divisions wrapping up their regular season this weekend.

item.title: Wanderers and Sporties captains anticipate ‘closer than ever’ clash in fifth straight grand final meeting
item.description: Wanderers and Sportsmans are gearing up to play their fifth-straight Young Motors T20 Women’s grand final against each other, but their grand final track records against each other could not be more different.

item.title: Geraldton home prices up 5.8 per cent in quarter, as new Cotality report confirms red-hot regional WA market
item.description: Geraldton’s property prices surged 5.8 per cent in the three months to January, according to new data, which has the red-hot regional WA market leading the national pack.

item.title: Five Mid West doctors praised for their dedication to rural communities with over 20 years of service
item.description: The dedication and long-term service of five doctors in the Mid West have been recognised by Rural Health West and WA Country Health Service in an award ceremony last week.

item.title: Politicians in the making? Geraldton MLA Kirrilee Warr wants to hear opinions of Mid West’s young people
item.description: Geraldton MP Kirrilee Warr is inviting local young people to take part in a Youth Advisory Council, where they can share their thoughts on local, state, and national issues.

item.title: Geraldton Bendigo Bank Cricket round 14: Chapman Valley-Northampton face Towns test while on brink of finals
item.description: Chapman Valley-Northampton face tough twin Towns tests, as they continue making a last minute tilt for a spot in Geraldton Bendigo Bank Cricket finals this season.

item.title: Stuart Parsonage: Geraldton police officer accused of unlawful computer, surveillance use — no show in court
item.description: A Geraldton police officer charged with a series of offences over the alleged unlawful use of computers and surveillance devices has been a no show in court for medical reasons.

item.title: Wanderers power to fifth straight Young Motors T20 Women’s cricket title against Sporties
item.description: Wanderers have claimed their fifth successive Young Motors Women’s T20 cricket title with a resounding seven-wicket win over Sporties at Wonthella on Saturday night.

item.title: Geraldton water polo: B52’s bag A-grade men’s three-peat in thrilling grand final decided by penalty shootout
item.description: B52’s completed a clean sweep of all men’s grades at the Geraldton Waterpolo Association grand finals on Saturday, with the men’s top side edging Demons in a match that went down to the wire at Aquarena.

item.title: Geraldton water polo: B52’s A-grade women seal sixth straight title, Serpents snap 13-year drought
item.description: B52’s produced a stunning comeback to claim the women’s A-grade shield at the Aquarena on Saturday, overturning a four-goal deficit to defeat Demons 12-11 and secure their sixth consecutive championship.
